q.line: Turns us like stones into drifters
stanza: It runs through me like a river
While time spits in my face
Turns us like stones into drifters

partner.line: It runs through me like a river

q.line: I fell in with some drifters
stanza: I fell in with some drifters
Winn Dixie cold cuts and highway hand me downs
And I wound up fixing dinner
Thinking back down the roads to then
They were overflowing in the refuge of the roads
